description: This file defines a Spring Boot REST controller named HelloController, providing basic informational endpoints such as welcome message, health check, documentation redirect, and application info.

classes.name: HelloController
classes.description: A REST controller providing basic informational endpoints such as welcome, health check, documentation redirect, and application info.

methods.name: hello
methods.description: Returns a welcome message indicating the application is running.

methods.name: docs
methods.description: Redirects the user to the Swagger UI documentation page, preserving the original request scheme, host, and port.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Returns a simple string indicating the application's health status.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Provides basic information about the running application.
